metadata.design: 30 static profile-plus-proposal cases; 10 dev and 20 heldout. These cases do not test persistence, favorite storage, profile revisions, or request lifecycle.
metadata.synthetic_data_note: Catalog rows marked provenance_kind=synthetic_fixture use invented composition values and fixture-only restriction_coverage. They are not nutrition or safety facts. Source URLs support only broad label/allergen assumptions; no clinical claims are tested.
metadata.portion_note: All gram quantities are synthetic test inputs and not serving advice.

food_composition.title: USDA FoodData Central
food_composition.scope: Only source-record provenance for the three reviewed rows reused from the writer fixture; synthetic rows are not USDA records.

allergen_context.title: FDA Food Allergies
allergen_context.scope: General major-allergen context only; fixture-made items and their coverage fields are synthetic test data.
